name: Venice
tagline: A city to explore from land and lagoon
summary: Reserve the major San Marco sights, then spend the rest of the visit walking away from the busiest lanes. A vaporetto ride and a lagoon island make more sense with at least two nights.
seasonNote: Expect bridges, tides and weather disruption; crowded event dates need early lodging reservations.
arrival: Arrive at Venezia Santa Lucia for the historic city; airport buses reach Piazzale Roma, while water transport serves different stops.
gettingAround: Walk and use ACTV vaporetti. Check the stop and direction carefully; bridges make luggage transfers slower.
cashTip: Keep small EUR cash for snacks; compare water-transit passes with your actual planned journeys. The 2026 access-fee trial ended 27 July; check the official 2027 calendar before future travel.
foodTip: Try cicchetti and seafood in smaller neighbourhood venues; check cover charges and menu prices.
buyTip: Look for documented Murano glass or local crafts; very cheap souvenirs may be imported.

connections.note: Typical direct high-speed journey; use Venezia Santa Lucia for the historic centre.
